item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas brnag pa las kyi sgrol byang
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi las kha/ dbal mo las kyi thig le'i cha lag zlog pa 'khor lo stong khyab kyi blo ldeg rdeg bsad pa lcags kyu 'phrul gsal gyi zur byang / sbyin sreg gsal ba 'od rgyan gyi rno mdel/ bsnyen sgrub las kyi kha tshar/ brnag pa las kyi sgrol byang*/ 'gug sgrol bstab pa'i 'phrin las zhes bya ba/ rim par brgyud nas klu grub ye shes snying pos man ngag zab thus kyi skor du gsungs nas rim par brgyud de/ phyis bla chen dran pa nam mkhas rje blon stang gsum ra sangs khod ram dang bzhi la gsungs pa'i nang nas/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis sa sprel lo rgyal nya yi nub mor/ bdag btsun pa kun dga' tshul khrims la brgyud de me stag lor gtan la phab pas/ dgra bgegs rtsad nas brlag par shog/
